findings.summary: Truncated text is revealed only on hover or focus-within, so touch users can never read it (this also hits every SidebarNavTree label).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-7. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.css:82-103 and :122-128 activation selectors are :hover/:focus-within/[data-autoplay] only; packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar-nav-tree/sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:37-41, 176-180, 277-279 wrap labels in TextTicker.
findings.fix: Reveal on tap/press for coarse pointers or expose the full text (e.g. title or a tooltip trigger) and document it.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: On phones the Sidebar spreads its div props onto the Sheet root, so className, id, aria-*, style and ref are dropped there but applied on desktop.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-8. packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.tsx:272 <Sheet onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} open={openMobile} {...props}> vs :305-314 container and :256-266 static div.
findings.fix: Forward className/style/ref/DOM props to SheetContent on the mobile path; keep only Sheet root props on <Sheet>.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: The active menu button and sub-button are marked only by a background fill, which disappears in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-9. packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.css:496-504, :747 fill only; grep -c forced-colors sidebar.css = 0; packages/ui-react/src/styles/recipes.test.ts:443-462 list omits sidebar, calendar and carousel.
findings.fix: Add an @media (forced-colors: active) rule painting active items in Highlight/HighlightText and add sidebar to the recipes test list.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Selected and range days are drawn only by background, so the selection is invisible in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-10; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:204-214; grep -c forced-colors calendar.css = 0.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors rule (Highlight/HighlightText on selected, a border on range-middle) and add calendar to recipes.test.ts 'state that survives forced colors'.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The day focus ring is the focus colour at 50% alpha, weaker than every other control's ring and likely below 3:1 on the selected fill.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-11; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:241-245 color-mix(in oklch, var(--a63-focus-ring) 50%, transparent); nav buttons use the full ring at :95-98.
findings.fix: Use the standard ring (var(--a63-control-focus-ring-color, var(--a63-focus-ring))) with an offset so it reads on the selected fill.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Calendar silently drops every caller classNames key it does not style itself (root, selected, disabled, week, month_grid and others).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-12; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.tsx:86 destructures classNames out of props; :115-123 copies only keys of defaultClassNames.
findings.fix: Start from {...classNames} and cn() the default class into each known key.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Day buttons are 36px on a coarse-pointer device outside the phone form factor, below the 44px target.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-13; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.css:11-14 --cell-size = max(control-height-lg, control-min-size); atom63 token --a63-control-height-lg = space-unit*9 (36px) and --a63-control-min-size touch = 2rem.
findings.fix: Floor --cell-size at --a63-control-min-target (2.75rem on touch) and add a touch/phone story with a baseline.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: Localization and direction are only partly wired: the month dropdown ignores the locale prop, day labels append English words, and RTL depends on both an ancestor dir attribute and DayPicker's own dir prop.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-14; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.tsx:155 toLocaleString('default', ...); :67-68 'Today, ' and ', selected'; calendar.css:106-108 [dir='rtl'] chevron flip vs react-day-picker 10.0.2 DayPicker.js:178-182 and 270/297 (keys and around-nav chevrons follow props.dir only).
findings.fix: Format with options.locale?.code, take the today/selected words from the caller's labels, read direction from context or computed style and pass it as dir, and add an RTL story.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: No phone or touch story exists, so calendar behaviour at 390px and on coarse pointers is never captured.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-15; unchanged at f7e5e419. calendar.stories.tsx exports Playground, Range, DropdownCaption, MultipleMonths, Themes, Endpoints, ContractMetadata only.
findings.fix: Add a Phone story (390px baseline) inside layout='phone' or a Popover.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: With cursorIndicator, any click inside the carousel (a link in a slide, a dot, the Prev/Next button) also navigates by pointer half, causing double or wrong scrolls.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-16; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:243 root onClick=handleCursorClick, :201-215 no event.target check; test carousel.test.tsx:190 clicks only the root.
findings.fix: Ignore clicks whose target is inside an interactive element (closest('a,button,input,[role=button]')) or listen on the viewport only; add a test clicking a dot and a slide button.

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Caller props override internal wiring: a ref on Carousel replaces the direction/cursor ref, and onClick or disabled on CarouselPrevious/Next replaces navigation.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-17; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:248-250 ref before {...props}; :361-364 and :384-387 onClick/disabled before {...props}.
findings.fix: Merge refs; compose onClick (call the caller's, then scroll unless defaultPrevented) as SidebarTrigger does (sidebar.tsx:316-319).

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Arrow keys are captured for the whole region (breaking caret movement in inputs inside slides) and a vertical carousel uses Left/Right instead of Up/Down; dots vanish in forced colors.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-18; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.tsx:129-143 + :244 onKeyDownCapture with preventDefault; carousel.css:192-208 dot drawn only as ::before background, no forced-colors rule.
findings.fix: Handle keys in bubble phase and skip editable targets; map ArrowUp/Down for vertical; add a forced-colors rule (CanvasText rest, Highlight current).

findings.subject: carousel
findings.summary: Round dots keep a 24px-wide target on touch, below 44px.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-19; unchanged at f7e5e419. carousel.css:170-172 --carousel-dot-pitch: 1.5rem for shape='dot' regardless of pointer; :181-185 width = pitch.
findings.fix: Use max(1.5rem, var(--a63-control-min-target)) or a coarse-pointer override for the pitch.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: Orientation is a boolean `vertical` instead of the contract's orientation axis, and the props type omits ref (the only component typed with ComponentPropsWithoutRef).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-20; unchanged at f7e5e419. marquee.tsx:12, :26; marquee-contract.ts:6 orientations horizontal|vertical with no default; grep ComponentPropsWithoutRef in ui-react components: 1 file.
findings.fix: Add orientation?: MarqueeOrientation (default 'horizontal' in the contract) and deprecate vertical; type props as ComponentProps<'div'>.

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: The pause toggle and running state are never captured, because visual tests run with reduced motion, which hides the toggle.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-21; unchanged at f7e5e419. apps/storybook/vitest.config.ts:109 reducedMotion 'reduce'; marquee.css:97-99; ui-react-marquee-pause-toggle-chromium-linux.png shows no toggle.
findings.fix: Give the PauseToggle story reducedMotion 'no-preference' with the animation paused (paused state is deterministic) so the toggle over content is baselined.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: Parts take no DOM props or ref, and SidebarNavCollapsibleItem has no uncontrolled mode (open and onOpenChange are required).
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-22; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:77-86, 128-152, 213-228, 285-293, 319-322 closed interfaces; :224-225 required open/onOpenChange.
findings.fix: Extend each props type with the wrapped element's props and spread them; add defaultOpen to SidebarNavCollapsibleItem.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: The section toggle's name is hardcoded English ('Expand X' / 'Collapse X') with no prop to localize it, and there is no RTL story.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-23; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:254; sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx has no RightToLeft export.
findings.fix: Use a static, caller-provided toggle label (e.g. toggleLabel, defaulting to the section label) and rely on aria-expanded for state; add an RTL story.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: No phone story, and long labels rely on the hover/focus ticker, so truncated labels are unreadable on touch.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-24; unchanged at f7e5e419. grep viewport|phone|mobile in sidebar-nav-tree.stories.tsx = 0; text-ticker.css:61-82.
findings.fix: Add a DarkSidebarPhone-style story with long labels; resolve with r2-k07-frame-7.

findings.subject: app-view
findings.summary: Default landmark names are music-app specific ('Library' for the panel, 'Player' for the docked bar), so other products ship wrong accessible names silently.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-27; unchanged at f7e5e419. app-view.tsx:94 bottomBarLabel='Player', :101 panelLabel='Library'.
findings.fix: Use neutral defaults (e.g. 'Sidebar', 'Toolbar') or require the label when the region is passed; mention it in the docs guidance.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: marqueeSpeed is a loop duration in seconds, so a higher 'speed' is slower.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-28. packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.tsx:41, :149 '--a63-text-ticker-duration': `${Math.max(1, marqueeSpeed)}s`.
findings.fix: Rename to marqueeDuration (keep marqueeSpeed as a deprecated alias) and document the unit.

findings.subject: calendar
findings.summary: The modern, aqua and retro calendars are visually identical; the declared archetypes do not show per theme.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-29; unchanged at f7e5e419. ui-react-calendar-themes-chromium-linux.png (only terminal differs).
findings.fix: Decide whether day cells and nav buttons should take the theme's control material (retro bevel, aqua gloss) like Button.

findings.subject: sidebar-nav-tree
findings.summary: The link-row toggle changes its name with its state while also exposing aria-expanded, so state is announced twice.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-31; unchanged at f7e5e419. sidebar-nav-tree.tsx:253-258.
findings.fix: Keep a static name and let aria-expanded carry the state (folds into r2-k07-frame-23).

findings.subject: marquee
findings.summary: useReducedMotion decides the markup during render (toggle, role, tabIndex), so server and reduced-motion client markup differ on hydration.
findings.evidence: Carried from r2-k07-frame-32; unchanged at f7e5e419. marquee.tsx:57-60, :86; apps/storybook/ssr/ssr.test.tsx only checks that renderToString succeeds.
findings.fix: Render the toggle and let CSS hide it under reduced motion (already done at marquee.css:97-99), and set the scroll-region attributes after mount.

findings.subject: sidebar
findings.summary: The rail hairline is still placed with physical left, and the RTL story covers only the static collapsible="none" sidebar, so the desktop collapsible path under dir=rtl has no baseline.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/sidebar/sidebar.css:261 (left: 50%), :288 (left: 100% for offcanvas); sidebar.stories.tsx:284-288 RightToLeft renders <Sidebar collapsible="none">.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start on the rail ::after, and add a RightToLeft story with the default offcanvas/icon sidebar inside a fixed-height frame, with a baseline.

findings.subject: text-ticker
findings.summary: Reduced motion and ResizeObserver re-measurement are still untested; the new tests cover overflow, autoPlay and the pause toggle only.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/text-ticker/text-ticker.test.tsx:64-147 (no matchMedia/useReducedMotion stub, no resize callback).
findings.fix: Stub useReducedMotion to assert no toggle and no data-control, and fire the ResizeObserver callback to assert data-overflowing flips.
